Activity. See which applications and websites your team uses, and how much of that time is active.
Open Activity. Choose a period: today, yesterday, seven days or thirty days. Filter by team, or pick one person.
The tiles show tracked time, active time, and the number of applications used. Active time is time with keyboard or mouse input.
Application usage lists each application, with its time, its share of the tracked time, and how much of it was active.
Switch to Websites, to see the domains visited. Only the domain is recorded, never the full address, and only when website tracking is on.
With no person selected, the People column shows how many people used each application.
For one person's day, open their profile, and choose the Activity tab. Use the arrows to move between days.
The timeline lists each application in order, with the time, the duration, and the active share. Hover a block to see the window title.
Activity shows what was used, not whether it was productive. That is decided by your productivity rules.
Done. You have now seen every part of WorkPulse.
